name: main
_comment: The client in the session you are sitting in. Empty user = whoever is logged on here. Without an instances.json beside this file, this single entry is the whole registry.

name: second
_comment: A client in its own Windows session. Replace the name and the user with an account that exists on THIS machine — there is no default that is right on somebody else's, which is why this entry is an example and not shipped as one. Bring it up with tools/rdp_instance.py --user <that login> --port 47655 (or by hand with tools/start_instance.cmd 47655 from inside that session). One port per instance; the daemon of each attaches to the client of its own session.
